name: manual_60a812
claim: Treat a history rewrite as cleanup, never as a safeguard: rewrite on a throwaway mirror, confirm the new tip's tree hash equals the old tip's, scan every rewritten commit, pin the push with force-with-lease to the expected SHA, and let the operator run it. Then confirm with ls-remote and request a host purge, because old SHAs stay reachable.
conditions: removing sensitive data from a repository
